svg.title: Frontend architecture: components, zustand stores, socket transport and backend
svg.desc: App.jsx renders Home, which is always mounted and listens for ws-message events. Home renders one route at a time. Routes read and write three zustand stores. The socketStore sends messages through socket.jsx to the backend, and incoming messages come back as ws-message window events. File uploads go over HTTP.
svg.text: Outlet renders one route at a time
